name: mts-dimension-warp
title: MTS Dimension Warp
author: bits-orio
description: Per-team Dimension Warp for Multi-Team Support: every team warps its own base, on its own clock, through its own deterministic sequence of dimensions, racing to stabilize them. A fork of Dimension Warp by Anakhon (BSD-3-Clause), rebuilt on the MTS mts-v1 API. Requires Multi-Team Support.
